title: Expert-Guided Rubrics as Dense Reward Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Non-Verifiable Domains
abstract: arXiv:2610.26932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in non-verifiable domains such as financial services, where they must interpret user intent, rewrite queries, and retrieve information under domain-specific constraints. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can train such agents from the consequences of their actions, recent successes largely rely on verifiable tasks with automatically computed binary rewards. In non-verifiable retrieval tasks, assessing query quality requires scarce subject-matter expert (SME) judgment that is inherently graded rather than binary. With Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), sparse rewards yield no useful learning signal when all sampled outputs within a group receive the same outcome, causing optimization to stall. We introduce a method that converts a small, fixed investment of SME judgment into a dense reward and combines it with retrieval-based metrics to form a hybrid,

translated_title: 专家引导的评分标准作为非可验证领域强化学习的密集奖励信号
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.26932v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为金融服务等非可验证领域中的自主智能体，在这些领域中，它们必须解释用户意图、重写查询，并在特定领域约束下检索信息。尽管强化学习（RL）可以通过行动的后果来训练此类智能体，但近期的成功主要依赖于具有自动计算二元奖励的可验证任务。在非可验证的检索任务中，评估查询质量需要稀缺的主题专家（SME）判断，而这种判断本质上是分级的而非二元的。在使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）时，当组内所有采样输出都获得相同结果时，稀疏奖励无法产生有用的学习信号，导致优化停滞。我们提出了一种方法，将少量固定的SME判断投入转化为密集奖励，并将其与基于检索的指标相结合，形成一种混合的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出将少量固定的主题专家判断转化为基于评分标准的密集奖励信号，并结合检索指标解决GRPO在非可验证领域中因稀疏奖励导致优化停滞的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes converting a small, fixed investment of subject-matter expert judgment into expert-guided rubric-based dense reward signals, combined with retrieval-based metrics, to overcome GRPO's optimization stall caused by sparse rewards in non-verifiable domains.
